schema.title: Response List Habits Api V1 Habits Get

post.description: The XP per completion (15 by default) is fixed when the habit is created.

delete.description: Archives the habit; earned XP and the history stay.

post.description: Mark the habit done for today (local date). XP is awarded once per day.
Cover a missed day (a week for weekly habits) so the streak is kept. 2 per month by default.

get.description: All cycles, the newest first: the open one and the history.

schema.title: Response List Cycles Api V1 Cycles Get

post.description: Start a cycle of any length (7-366 days). Only one cycle can be open at a time.

get.description: The open (active or paused) cycle, or null.

schema.title: Response Current Cycle Api V1 Cycles Current Get

delete.description: Cancel the open cycle: it stays in the history, without a report or reward.

patch.description: current_value can be set only for manual goals; the others are counted.

post.description: The paused days are added to the end date when the cycle resumes.

Sum the cycle up: the report is saved as a snapshot. After the end date it gives
200 XP x the share of goals done; finishing early gives no reward.

get.description: Plan against reality for the last 7 and 30 complete days (today is still open).

Pending recommendations first, then recent decisions.

Asking refreshes them: new ones appear when the last days call for it, outdated
ones expire. The plan itself changes only when a recommendation is applied.

schema.title: Response List Recommendations Api V1 Adaptive Recommendations Get

post.description: Apply the chosen changes (all by default) together, or none if the plan has changed.
Nothing changes; the same advice does not come back for a while.

get.description: The whole catalog with the player's progress; unlocked ones carry unlocked_at.
